extracted.name: Tempeh and Anchovy Burger
extracted.description: This is my experiment for Weekend Challenge at Cookpad Indonesia. They wanted us to cook something with Tempeh (Indonesian soy product, fermented soybean) and anchovy as main ingredients. I chose to make something fancy with these simple and cheap ingredients 😊
ingredient_lines: Chili sauce (if you like it spicy)
instruction_lines: Cut tempeh into dice and steam it for 15-20 minutes. Put steamed tempeh into a bowl and mash it with fork. Set aside.
Remove the heads and inwards of anchovy. Finely chop anchovy and garlics.
Heat the pan and melt margarine or butter. Put garlic, stir it until fragrance and add anchovy. Cook it about 5 minutes until anchovies cooked. Set aside
Mix cooked anchovy with mashed tempeh. Add all purpose flour, bread flour, soy sauce, salt, pepper and 3/4 part of beaten egg (the rest will be used for coating the patty). Mix it well.
Divide patty dough into two. Shape into patty about 5 inches wide (depends on the wide of burger bun)
Put patty into egg mixture and coat it with bread crumbs
Heat the oil with low fire and fry patty until it becomes golden brown.
Spread butter on burger bun, and grilled it for 3 minutes
Put mayonnaise and other ingredients on burger as you like
Tempeh and Anchovy Burger is ready to serve 🍔✨
